matter_background.original: Lal Perera gifted his house and property in extent of 10 perches at Kadawatha to his son Kasun subject to Life interest of Donor and his Wife. The present märket value of the house and property is Rs.4,000,000/ The Commissioner of the Western Provincial Council Revenue Department in his opinion regarding stamp duty values it as Rs. 6,000,000/-.
